ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 92:8 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity black mass covering the majority of the surface area. High-intensity white contiguous blobs are localized at the distal tips of both left and right lobes. Multiple small high-contrast white focal spots are distributed across the central vertical axis and the interior of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 58 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration with variable pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys extending along the entire trailing edge; notably more jagged at the extreme distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex parabolic curve originating from the peduncle region and sweeping laterally and upward toward the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 10-12 discrete circular white pixel clusters (3-10 pixel diameter) primarily located in the lower-central and mid-right lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct white linear pixel disruptions including vertical marks in the lower central fluke and horizontal rake-like marks in the mid-central region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white linear scarring across the central fluke surface and several irregular micro-notches/chips along the trailing edge profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Broad, high-intensity white pigmentation concentrated at the extreme distal 5-8 percent of both lobe tips.
